title: Gödel Implication on Finite Chains: Catalan Enumeration and a Continuum Limit Law
summary: We study the distribution of output values produced by all fully bracketed implication terms on $n$ distinct variables in Gödel $m$-valued logic on the finite chain $V_m$. The Catalan decomposition of bracketings yields a stratified system of recurrences for the output counts. Passing to tail sums reduces this system to a finite iteration of a single map $Φ_x$ and its inverse branch $Ψ_x$. For each fixed $m$, this reduction gives a common dominant square-root singularity at $r=1/(4m)$, coefficient asymptotics of order $(4m)^n n^{-3/2}$, and limiting proportions for every truth level.
